title: Fan-in bound for the tableau circuit family
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols and $C,d\in\mathbb{N}$. For each input length $n$, form the Boolean circuit encoding its configuration tableau for $(C+1)(n+1)^d$ steps, with no fixed input prefix. Every gate in every circuit of this family has at most two inputs; its input list has no repetitions, and each NOT gate has exactly one input.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean symbols
The conclusion applies to the circuit for every input length $n$
